name: SASTRA Deemed University
officialName: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA Deemed to be University)
summary: SASTRA began in 1984 as Shanmugha Engineering College and became a deemed-to-be university on 26 April 2001 under Section 3 of the UGC Act. Based in Thanjavur, it teaches engineering, management, law, sciences, humanities and education. NAAC re-accredited it in its fourth cycle with A++ (3.76/4.00), and it is a UGC Category I institution. B.Tech admission combines Class XII marks and JEE (Main) scores.

testing.notes: Combined with normalised Class XII aggregate for B.Tech merit.
